function: Device activity detection (which of K devices are active) for grant-free mMTC access with an IRS; not symbol detection, channel estimation, or RIS configuration (p. 3).
notes: Excluded under function, after codes 1 to 4 did not apply: research article (p. 1); not a survey; deep unfolding with trained F, B, stepsize and C_k is learned (p. 7); the network acts on the received signal Y, so it is physical layer (p. 7). The learned output is the activity estimate a_k, and the paper states 'the focus of this paper is on device activity detection' (p. 3), scored by missed-detection and false-alarm probabilities (p. 8). It recovers no data symbols, since the signature sequences are known at the BS (p. 3), so it is not area 1. It estimates no channel, since it uses statistical CSI from correlation matrices (p. 3), so it is not area 2. The IRS phase shifts come from an analytical design solved by projected gradient or manifold methods, not from the network (p. 6), so it is not area 3. Borderline for the reviewer: if activity detection is judged to be MIMO detection (area 1), the facts are a custom correlated Rayleigh simulator (p. 3), baselines GAMP, FCNN and GLRT (p. 10), only a qualitative statement of lower complexity (p. 2), and no code or data link.
